wargear.name: Night-mantle
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cloak of dark, light-eating fabric stitched with something that was once a man's hide. The model gains Shrouded (5+).

wargear.name: Gibbet standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A frame that carries the last enemy officer the unit caught, still in his armour. Every model in the unit gains Hatred (Infantry).

option.text: The Sergeant may take a murderer's weapon
The Headsman may take a Headsman's axe
Up to two models may take a Darkscope bolter
Up to four models may carry a Banshee pistol
The Sergeant may wear a Night-mantle
The unit may carry a Gibbet standard

modifiers.text: Night Raptors strike from above and are hit back: +1 I, -1 T.
Terror Squads revel in it and fear it: +1 WS, -1 CL.
The Flay-clade want the knife, not the gun: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Contekar, bitter and unbound: +1 A, -1 LD.

rules.name: Silent Knives
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Knives in the Dark). The sentry never saw the blade. On the turn a unit with this rule enters play from Reserves, enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against it.

rules.name: Dread Herald
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dread Procession). Fear walks ahead of them. An enemy unit charged by a unit with this rule reduces its Cool by a further 1 until the end of that Assault phase.

rules.name: Judgement of the Cabal
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Cabal of Murder). Before deployment, the controlling player names one enemy unit as the Condemned. Models with this rule may re-roll failed Hit Tests against that unit; if it is destroyed, name another at the start of the next turn.

rules.name: Tithe of Blood
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Headsman's Tithe). When a unit with this rule destroys an enemy unit in combat, every enemy unit within 12" reduces its Cool by 1 until the end of the turn.

rites.name: Knives in the Dark
rites.flavor: The first sign is a sentry who does not answer the next call.
benefits: Night Raptor Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).

Night Raptors, Reconnaissance Squads and Scout Squads gain Shrouded (6+) and Silent Knives: Outflank, and enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against them on the turn they arrive from Reserves.
limitations: At least one Night Raptor Squad is required.
No Armour units and no Heavy Transports.

modifiers.text: Knives in the Dark: Silent Knives, Outflank, Shrouded (6+).

require.note: Bring at least one Night Raptor Squad.

rites.name: Dread Procession
rites.flavor: They did not need to win the battle if the enemy could be persuaded to lose it first.
benefits: Tactical, Despoiler, Veteran Tactical, Assault, Veteran Assault and Reconnaissance Squads gain Fear (1).
Those squads gain Dread Herald: an enemy unit they charge reduces its Cool by a further 1 until the end of that Assault phase.
limitations: No Heavy sub-type Infantry (no Terminators, Breachers or Warders).
No Armour units and no Support units of any kind.

rites.name: Cabal of Murder
rites.flavor: Curze's trusted few do not take orders. They pass judgement on whoever gave them.
benefits: Contekar Terminator Squads and Atramentar Flay-clades may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Judgement of the Cabal: before deployment, name one enemy unit as the Condemned; the Cabal may re-roll failed Hit Tests against it.
limitations: Konrad Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
No Armour, Transport or Fast Attack units.

modifiers.text: Cabal of Murder: Line (1), Judgement of the Cabal.

require.note: Curze or Sevatar must lead the Cabal.

rites.name: The Headsman's Tithe
rites.flavor: A world pays in tithe, one way or another. The Eighth Legion simply prefers the other.
benefits: Terror Squads gain Fear (1) and Tithe of Blood: when they destroy an enemy unit in combat, enemy units within 12" reduce their Cool by 1 until the end of the turn.
limitations: Konrad Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
At least two Terror Squads are required.
No Praetors of any kind and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: The Headsman's Tithe: Fear (1), Tithe of Blood.

require.note: Bring at least two Terror Squads.
Curze or Sevatar must lead the army.
